Thank you for purchasing a Sit Right sofa. It will arrive at your home between 9 A.M.

and joy. We also hope your experience will support our mission to provide quality
comfort at an affordable price.

know, our virtual catalog includes armchairs, loveseats, decorative pillows, area rugs,
and much more. To obtain your discount, simply enter the code MATRO15 at checkout.
Again, thank you for your business.
Sincerely,
Juro Tada
Customer Service Specialist
